motions.purpose: Draw-in of chart elements when the chart enters view: lines trace, bars grow from the baseline, markers pop, bands and labels fade in with a short stagger.
motions.model: Solid observed lines animate stroke-dashoffset over their measured length; dashed epistemic styles fade instead (dash pattern must not be corrupted); bars scaleY from the y=0 baseline; stagger is capped at 900 ms.
motions.limitations: Purely presentational; encodes no data meaning. Order of appearance follows document order, not value order.
motions.reducedMotion: All elements render in their final state immediately.
motions.accessibility: The SVG carries role=img with an aria-label from the chart title; data is also available as text in captions per the chart rules.

motions.purpose: Violin (distribution) plots grow horizontally from their centerline on reveal (scaleX 0-1, ~90 ms stagger per violin), then quartile box, 5-95 whiskers and the median dot fade/pop in.
motions.model: Shape is a Gaussian-kernel KDE with Silverman bandwidth h = 0.9 * min(sigma, IQR/1.34) * n^(-1/5), evaluated at 48 evenly spaced points over [min-h, max+h]; quartiles/percentiles use linear interpolation (R-7). Fully deterministic, no randomness.
motions.limitations: Widths are normalized per violin (each scaled to its own max density): widths are NOT comparable across violins, only shapes and positions are. The KDE smooths h beyond the observed range, so tails extend slightly past the data. The grow animation itself is presentational; only the final shape is the analytic claim.
motions.reducedMotion: Final state immediately (no growth, no stagger).
motions.accessibility: SVG carries role=img with an aria-label; category names render as axis text; summary statistics (median, quartiles) are visible as static marks.

motions.purpose: chart.morphTo(patch) glides existing scatter points (matched by index) to their new positions, fades removed points out and pops added points in; bars glide via height scaling; lines crossfade over 300 ms because a path 'd' cannot tween.
motions.model: Pure playback of two caller-supplied datasets; no interpolation model beyond the visual easing between start and end positions.
motions.limitations: Axes do NOT rescale during a morph - fix the domain via x/y min/max or accept points moving off-plot. Index-based matching asserts identity: if point i in the old and new datasets is not the same entity, the glide fabricates a continuity that is not in the data. Intermediate positions during the glide carry no data meaning.
motions.reducedMotion: New data applied instantly; the returned promise resolves immediately.
motions.exportState: New data applied instantly, no transitions.
motions.accessibility: End states are complete static charts; the transition adds no information, so nothing is lost by skipping it.

motions.purpose: Presenter-triggered ONE-SHOT attention sweep (chart.sheen(i)): a short bright segment travels once along a line path and fades (~900 ms WAAPI); scatter points emit one expanding ring each (20 ms stagger); violins get a single outline brightness pulse. The overlay node is removed when the animation ends.
motions.model: None - decorative-adjacent focus cue that encodes no data. It is legitimate only because it is presenter-driven, single-shot and self-removing; use at most once per claim.
motions.limitations: Honest caveat: this is the closest the system comes to decoration. It must never loop, never persist a glow/drop-shadow, and must not substitute for an annotation or reference line when the emphasis IS the claim.
motions.reducedMotion: No-op: the call returns without rendering anything.
motions.exportState: No-op: nothing is rendered in export mode.
motions.accessibility: Carries no information, so its absence (reduced motion, export) loses nothing; the presenter's spoken claim plus static labels remain the record.
